ORDER granting Plaintiffs' motion for a preliminary injunction or, in the alternative, for a stay under 5 U.S.C. § 705 (Case No. 25-cv-3675, ECF No. 20; Case No. 25-cv-3777, ECF No. 21 ), construed as a motion for a stay under 5 U.S.C. § 705; granting in part and denying in part 33 Defendants' motion to dismiss; directing parties to file a joint status report indicating their positions on deadlines for discovery and dispositive motions within 14 days. The effective date of USCIS, PA-2025-21 (8/29/2025) and the corresponding update to the USCIS Policy Manual are stayed pursuant to 5 U.S.C. § 705 pending a final ruling on the merits of this case. The USCIS Policy Manual effective on 6/28/2017 is hereby reinstated pending final resolution of this case. Signed by Judge Adam B Abelson on 8/3/2026. (kk5s, Deputy Clerk) (Entered: 08/03/2026)
